name: OCR-VQA: Visual Question Answering by Reading Text in Images
description: OCR-VQA is a visual question answering benchmark focused on reading and comprehending embedded scene text in images, containing 1,002,146 question-answer instances across 207,572 book cover images spanning 32 genres.

license.name: Academic Research Use
license.notes: Released freely for academic research purposes on the official project website. The website specifies academic research use but does not provide an explicit open license (e.g., CC, MIT, Apache) or commercial grant.

source_references.title: OCR-VQA: Visual Question Answering by Reading Text in Images

verification.notes: Verified against ICDAR 2019 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ICDAR.2019.00156, IEEE document 8978122) and official dataset.json release. License status verified as unspecified_by_source because no standard OSI/Creative Commons license grant is provided. Exactly 1,002,146 question-answer pairs across 207,572 book cover images partitioned into train (801,680 QA pairs, 166,043 images), validation (100,037 QA pairs, 20,732 images), and test (100,429 QA pairs, 20,797 images) across 32 genres.

size.notes: Book cover images and JSON question-answer annotations.
